feed.title: Single-Cell Foundation Model Tracker — weekly changes
feed.subtitle: What moved in the single-cell foundation model field this week: new models, rank changes, repositories going quiet, and new benchmarking papers.

entry.title: Week of 2026-11-09: 30 changes
entry.content:
• Rank — SCimilarity climbs 8 places to #7 (score 60.8, +20.3).
  • Rank — GeneCompass falls 2 places to #10 (score 54.7, -0.8).
  • Upkeep — TranscriptFormer's repository has gone dormant — no commit in over a year.
  • Milestone — STATE passes 100 citations.
  • Milestone — SCimilarity passes 100 citations.
  • Milestone — CellFM passes 100 citations.
  • New evaluation — “Plate design confounds donor variation and model evaluation in single-cell perturbation screens” (bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)) — covers STATE. DOI
  • New evaluation — “An accuracy and calibration benchmark of scGPT pipelines and matched classical models for cell type annotation” (Scientific Reports) — covers scGPT, Geneformer, scBERT, scFoundation, UCE (Universal Cell Embeddings). DOI
  • New evaluation — “Where single-cell foundation models help: a benchmark of annotation, perturbation and regulatory inference against simple baselines” (bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)) — covers scGPT, Geneformer, scFoundation, Nicheformer, STATE. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Silent methodological failures in AI-assisted science: benchmarking large language model agents for virtual gene knockout analysis” (Research Square) — covers Geneformer. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Top2All: Benchmarking sparse-to-transcriptome reconstruction from high-expression profiles across sex- and sex-steroid-defined conditions” (bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)) — covers scGPT, Geneformer. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Do Language Models Know What Compelling Scientific Evidence Looks Like?” (arXiv (Cornell University)) — covers scGPT, Geneformer, STATE. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Averaging in gene perturbation benchmarks hides perturbation-strength variation: Consequences for model evaluation” (bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)) — covers STATE. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Genetic Perturbation Prediction Models Fail Out-of-Distribution: A Rigorous Benchmark and Systematic Evaluation” (bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)) — covers STATE. DOI
  • New evaluation — “A Pitfall in the Evaluation of Gene Perturbation Models” (arXiv (Cornell University)) — covers STATE. DOI
  • New evaluation — “SubcellPert: Benchmarking Subcellular Perturbation Prediction” (bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)) — covers scGPT, scFoundation, STATE. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Beyond the Final Layer: Evaluating Single-Cell Foundation Model Representations for Molecular Prediction” (bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)) — covers scGPT, Geneformer, scFoundation. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Benchmarking single-cell foundation models for aging biology” (bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)) — covers scGPT, Geneformer, scFoundation, UCE (Universal Cell Embeddings), SCimilarity, CellFM, scPRINT, TranscriptFormer. DOI
  • New evaluation — …and 43 further benchmarking papers.
  • Citations — 478 other citing papers newly indexed, none of them evaluations.
  • First comparison — First joint evaluation of CellPLM and scMulan.
  • First comparison — First joint evaluation of Geneformer and scMulan.
  • First comparison — First joint evaluation of Nicheformer and tGPT.
  • First comparison — First joint evaluation of scBERT and scMulan.
  • First comparison — First joint evaluation of SCimilarity and scPRINT.
  • First comparison — First joint evaluation of SCimilarity and STATE.
  • First comparison — First joint evaluation of SCimilarity and TranscriptFormer.
  • First comparison — First joint evaluation of scMulan and tGPT.
  • First comparison — First joint evaluation of scPRINT and STATE.
  • First comparison — First joint evaluation of scPRINT and tGPT.
